page.overview:
Who is Dragonsky?

Dragonsky is one of the oldest members of the Oktober Guard but age does not seem to be a factor to this man as he continues to serve in the name of his homeland. He appears able to operate just about every ground vehicle in the Russian arsenal; be it a 4-WD or a tank, his experience and intuition will guide him through. His favorite weapon, though, is a flamethrower of his own design which is quite powerful and surprises everyone with its range and ferocity. The obsession with flames may be attributed to that moment in his youth when invaders plowed through in their tanks and he joined his countrymen in warding them off with Molotov cocktails.

The head of the Dragonsky action figure is modeled after comic writer Brandon Jerwa.
